title: CR-012 Keyblock Echo
description: Source-backed V3.4 artifact transformation: translate the verified CR-001 adult fashion photograph into a contemporary Japanese woodblock-inspired relief print on a physical print sheet. Uses portrait_to_relief_print + japanese_woodblock_print + print_sheet + newly_created. Empty EraPack list—no Edo authenticity claim. Symbolic reference roles only; binary reference packaging is out of PromptRecipe scope. Operator must supply the verified CR-001 PNG (SHA-256 0dcf8af6cac15441d5e728f98ac53314442984d3a27a5dd193effa2bac46f41e) as the image input at generation time. See docs/CR_012_KEYBLOCK_ECHO.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Transform the referenced adult fashion photograph into a newly printed Japanese woodblock-inspired relief print on a physical print sheet, shown as a finished sheet under quiet even light. Preserve recognizable visual identity of the source adult figure, the distinguishing standing stance and key anatomical proportions, the architectural evening-gown silhouette and structural construction, and the hairstyle silhouette, but translate photographic skin, satin reflectance, and continuous tonal modeling into carved-keyblock-inspired contours, deliberately separated ink-color regions, controlled planar value, and credible multi-block color relationships on absorbent paper. The result must read as marks impressed on a physical sheet—not a living photograph with paper texture overlay, not a generic anime or cartoon filter, not a vector illustration without print material cues, not an ink-wash painting, not a watercolor, and not an authenticated Edo-period or historically attributed handmade print. Keep sheet-conscious composition with an intentional paper boundary and margins, restrained printmaking irregularities, plausible registration and impression character, and no logos or invented typography.

locks.primary_subject: same adult fashion subject as the source reference photograph

references.notes: Authoritative private CR-001 verified import original. SHA-256 0dcf8af6cac15441d5e728f98ac53314442984d3a27a5dd193effa2bac46f41e. Resolve the locally verified CR-001 original through private candidate/import evidence during operator handoff. PromptRecipe encodes symbolic roles only; the operator must attach that PNG to the later image request. The SHA identifies bytes and does not prove upload. Outfit role preserves recognizable gown construction and silhouette for print reinterpretation—it does not lock photographic satin reflectance or pixel-level dress texture.
